sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 80 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Applies Revolutionary Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases Ability Power of critical hits by 30, and reduces Ability Cost consumption by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
